title: PS4 Baikal qualification checklist — alpha proposals, not hardware results

target.other_models: Require their own scoped plan and evidence; no inherited qualification.

safety_policy: This source CLI never invokes tests, commands, network, driver recovery, power or storage operations.
A later hardware experiment needs explicit task authority, one coherent bounded completed UART session, declared timeout and rollback.
No automatic retry, reset, unload, unbind, rearm, DMA cleanup, fan/clock writes, disk mounts/writes/format or image growth.
Unimplemented/deferred/skipped/unsupported is never PASS. No report or complete checklist automatically means STABLE.
Ordinary uvd_runtime=false means decode unsupported/not tested, not decode failure. Browser video is not proof of UVD.
Evidence input is a human-reviewed summary, not raw runner JSON. The CLI checks declared identities/counts/oracles, not authenticity or the underlying private logs.
limitations: The default profile is a proposed frozen-build Baikal baseline, not every PS4 model or every Linux feature.
Historical two-boot Ethernet autoload evidence is preserved; the current ordinary-use stability proposal requires three cold boots.
Wireless remains working in its recorded firmware-equipped scopes; broad reinvestigation is deferred pending detailed reproducible bugs.
Native 48 kHz, suspend/hibernate, unqualified controls and UVD lifecycle gaps remain visible even when outside a selected mandatory profile.
Internal-root installation, raw-disk I/O, encrypted extent-map activation, Orbis writes and autoexpand are outside this checklist; inventory is not storage support.
UVD scope is experimental Liverpool 8-bit NV12 AVC 1080p30 / one handle; no HEVC, VCE, 4K or ordinary PM/cleanup claim.
Additional CPU/RAM/display/browser/USB/HID/RTC counts are alpha proposals requiring review before any hardware sequence.

kernel-baseline.title: Ordinary Baikal kernel baseline; excludes experimental UVD/native48/suspend/internal installation

desktop-integration.title: Baseline plus native Wayland and both browser integration suites

uvd-experimental.title: Separate experimental AVC scope; no ordinary PM, reset or teardown claim

checks.title: Freeze the complete model/build identity
checks.scope: One identified Baikal console, loader/payload, kernel/config/modules/initramfs/rootfs; actual loaded Mesa and external firmware pins.
checks.evidence: Boot-set and source receipts plus observed identities. A manifest declaration is not a hash of the running kernel.

checks.title: Resolve remaining source blockers
checks.scope: ICC transaction ownership/response lengths, bounded ICC status processing and AHCI IRQ-allocation failure bookkeeping remain listed as open.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Verify the external rescue/rollback entrance
checks.scope: Known external boot set, usable text recovery/SSH and operator recovery instructions; no automatic recovery action.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Repeat cold boot to usable Linux
checks.scope: Three cold boots of one frozen set; stable console identity, usable display/input/root, no unexplained boot fault.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Verify default and explicitly overridden boot policy
checks.scope: Declared loader: no supplied arguments, individual override retaining omitted defaults, and explicit full override; root/recovery remain valid.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Record complete read-only inventory
checks.scope: CPU/RAM, PCI/DRM/USB/input/thermal/block metadata, firmware availability and configuration. Enumeration alone is not functionality.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Establish monitored cooling limits before load
checks.scope: Read-only sensors and independent cooling/fan observation; declare an approved temperature ceiling and stop plan before sustained load. Baikal fan RPM/PWM is not qualified.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Check the known computation oracle
checks.scope: Existing 1-worker SHA-256 oracle, 2-second setting. This is a bounded computation check, not all-core stress.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Check owned RAM patterns
checks.scope: 32 MiB owned buffers, patterns 0/85/170/255, existing reserve and allocation caps; no physical-memory or VRAM access.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Qualify per-core computation under monitored load
checks.scope: All reported logical CPUs exercised with a reviewed finite workload; stop at the declared thermal limit; no clock/voltage/fan writes.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Qualify repeated safe RAM allocations
checks.scope: Multiple owned buffers and allocation/exit cycles within the declared safe reserve; cover a documented amount, never claim all physical RAM.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Observe cooling during bounded CPU/GPU work
checks.scope: At least 30 minutes per boot of reviewed load/idle observation, with credible temperature sampling and an external stop operator.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Qualify native first publication on cold boots
checks.scope: Three cold boots, cable present and absent at launch. Normal network manager opens psx0, MTU 1500 polling; exactly one retained DMA generation.
checks.basis: current finish-plan gate; historical autoload gate remains two boots
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Verify bidirectional peer transfers and HTTPS
checks.scope: Each boot: independently hash-checked 1 GiB in each direction, bound HTTPS, actual throughput and CPU cost. Use an explicit external peer.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Sustain mixed wired traffic and idle/resume
checks.scope: At least 60 minutes mixed TX/RX/simultaneous traffic and idle on one healthy retained generation; compare loss with a control NIC/RJ45 path.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Recover healthy cable/admin cycles
checks.scope: Five unplug/replug and five healthy down/up cycles within a declared recovery deadline; retain the original DMA. No unload/reset/unbind/rearm.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Observe ordinary clean power-off externally
checks.scope: Ordinary native kernel only: three clean power-off cycles, actual power state and sync/unmount evidence, healthy next Linux/Orbis startup. CLI never powers off.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Verify Orbis networking after Linux
checks.scope: After a clean ordinary Linux power-off, a normal Orbis boot retains working networking. No Linux driver reset or unload.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Recorded Wi-Fi scope / detailed regression gate
checks.scope: Working on recorded firmware-equipped setups. Reopen only for a reproducible bug with model, chip/USB/SDIO IDs, exact firmware, operation and logs.
checks.basis: deferred priority; proposed future per-device gate
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Recorded Bluetooth scope / detailed regression gate
checks.scope: Preserve recorded successes. New pairing/reconnect investigation needs a specific device/chip/firmware report; no automatic pairing or radio changes.
checks.basis: deferred priority; proposed future per-device gate
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Qualify selected external USB devices/read paths
checks.scope: Identify selected root/data devices and controller paths across boots; checksum 10 reads of a disposable reference on an already-mounted read-only data source. Never unplug a mounted root.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Record internal SATA inventory without I/O
checks.scope: Stable PCI/sysfs identity, model, size, completion/PHY profile and node presence only; no disk open, mapping/mount, repair, Orbis mutation or image growth.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Qualify the declared Xorg display/input session
checks.scope: Three launches/cold boots of the exact Mesa/Xorg stack; visible desktop/menu/input for 30 minutes, correct geometry, no crash/freeze.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Verify declared HDMI mode, picture and cadence
checks.scope: Exact display/cable/mode/VRAM configuration: visible color/geometry patterns and30minutes output. Configured refresh and browser rAF are distinct from physical refresh measurement.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Match hardware OpenGL reference pixels
checks.scope: Pinned loaded Mesa/radeonsi hardware renderer, known rendered pixels and exact download oracle; eglinfo alone is insufficient.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Match hardware Vulkan reference pixels
checks.scope: Pinned loaded Mesa/RADV hardware renderer and known reference image. Vulkan enumeration or vkcube alone is not an oracle.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Qualify bounded graphics load and session reuse
checks.scope: 30minutes per boot with reviewed scene/window changes and responsive SSH/input/display. Terminal faults stop the session; no automatic reset or driver teardown.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Qualify native Wayland as its own stack
checks.scope: Optional pinned Wayland provider/compositor: real EGL/output/input for 30 minutes on 3 cold boots. Package closure or Xwayland output does not establish native Wayland.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Qualify Firefox baseline and frame pacing
checks.scope: Exact browser/version/profile and actual renderer; capabilities, Canvas2D, WebGL known pixels,10 s rAF pacing and video counter deltas. Chromium needs its separately pinned optional provider.
checks.evidence: Per-test saved records, UA/renderer, median/p95/p99 intervals, missed-frame estimate, configured mode and per-run video counters. rAF is not physical refresh; browser playback is not UVD proof.

checks.title: Qualify Chromium baseline and frame pacing
checks.scope: Exact browser/version/profile and actual renderer; capabilities, Canvas2D, WebGL known pixels,10 s rAF pacing and video counter deltas. Chromium needs its separately pinned optional provider.
checks.evidence: Per-test saved records, UA/renderer, median/p95/p99 intervals, missed-frame estimate, configured mode and per-run video counters. rAF is not physical refresh; browser playback is not UVD proof.

checks.title: Qualify supported 44.1 kHz HDMI output
checks.scope: 44.1 kHz output: hashed44.1 and48 kHz source material through the supported/resampled path, with audible channel/pitch/duration checks and no persistent underruns.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Native 48 kHz remains a separate gap
checks.scope: No verified native 48 kHz fix; resampling48 kHz content to44.1 kHz is not this gate. New work needs a discriminating bridge/HDA reference.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Verify keyboard/mouse/controller input
checks.scope: Exact USB/Bluetooth HID identities: all selected keys/buttons/axes, sustained input and5 supported reconnect cycles. Device nodes alone do not prove events.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Qualify a selected USB audio device separately
checks.scope: If claimed: exact USB device, selected playback/capture formats and actual audible/recorded oracle; HDMI results do not cover it.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Verify RTC/timekeeping without setting the clock
checks.scope: Read-only comparison with an independent reference over 10 minutes and across declared cold/warm boots; report drift and RTC retention. No clock writes.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Review and separately observe native reboot
checks.scope: Source-reviewed reboot path, then 3 externally observed warm reboot cycles, sync/unmount and usable next boot. Power-off does not qualify reboot; CLI never reboots.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Suspend/hibernate source gap
checks.scope: Retained-DMA quiescence/restore is not established. Excluded from the ordinary scope; no suspend attempt until source/lifecycle work is ready.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Verify the separate UVD artifact and session prerequisites
checks.scope: Experimental Liverpool AVC variant only: exact kernel/modules/Mesa/external firmware, explicit runtime enablement, boot-bound UART assertion and cold-boot/recovery limits.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Match canonical 120 and native 900 AVC frames
checks.scope: Forced VAAPI hardware decoding, software fallback disabled; every NV12 byte/hash for canonical 120-frame and 1920x1080p30 native 900-frame references, one active handle.
checks.evidence: The alpha uvd.avc action supplies one bounded canonical reference component. Full qualification also needs native 900-frame output, all three frozen-set cold boots, actual loaded libraries and lifecycle evidence. A smoke report alone cannot meet this gate.

scenarios.title: 128x96 exact 120-frame baseline
scenarios.fixture: Pinned H.264 input and software-decoded NV12 reference; 128x96, exactly 120 frames, 8-bit 4:2:0.
scenarios.preparation: Existing Graphics > UVD AVC reference action (uvd.avc), matched corrected alpha firmware/kernel/Mesa and CPU/RAM prerequisites. No fixture or command parameters are added.
scenarios.sequence: One existing baseline action per physical cold boot. Repeat on three distinct physical cold boots of the same frozen artifact set; never rerun on the same boot, including after PASS.
scenarios.evidence: Save exact 120-frame and whole-output hashes, zero mismatches, forced hardware/no software fallback, actual loaded libraries and completed UART for each boot. This is only the canonical component: it does not satisfy the native 900-frame or lifecycle gates.
scenarios.limits: One explicit UVD attempt is the final active action of a fresh physical cold boot. Record completed UART continuity and keep capture running through physical power-off/known-good Orbis recovery. No same-boot retry, second decoder, reset, unload, unbind, rearm, suspend or automatic Linux power recovery.

scenarios.title: 720p30 exact-reference fixture
scenarios.fixture: Planned 1280x720 at 30 fps, 900 frames / 30 seconds, 8-bit H.264 to NV12. No runnable alpha fixture is installed.
scenarios.preparation: Create and review pinned encoded input, complete software NV12 reference/per-frame hashes, encoder/decoder versions and crop/stride conversion; add a bounded typed harness before hardware use. Use bounded streaming comparison buffers and declare an optional-storage budget; 900 raw 1080p NV12 frames are about 2.8 GB, outside the 1 GiB core. Never load a whole raw clip/reference into RAM.
scenarios.sequence: After fixture/harness review, use one bounded final UVD action within the authorized experiment on each fresh physical cold boot. Use the same frozen build across the proposed three-boot comparison; no current-menu parameter can select this scenario.
scenarios.evidence: Compare every output frame and visible NV12 sample to the exact reference; collect frame count, mismatches, hardware identity, software fallback count and UART faults. This planned scenario does not replace the existing 1080p native gate.
scenarios.limits: One explicit UVD attempt is the final active action of a fresh physical cold boot. Record completed UART continuity and keep capture running through physical power-off/known-good Orbis recovery. No same-boot retry, second decoder, reset, unload, unbind, rearm, suspend or automatic Linux power recovery.

scenarios.title: 1080p30 exact-reference integration
scenarios.fixture: Planned 1920x1080 at 30 fps, 900 frames / 30 seconds, 8-bit H.264 to NV12. Historical native 900-frame evidence is not an installed alpha action.
scenarios.preparation: Review or recreate the native 900-frame fixture with exact input/reference/tool hashes, freeze it for this build and implement a bounded alpha harness. Preserve the existing native_frames >= 900 acceptance requirement. Use bounded streaming comparison buffers and declare an optional-storage budget; 900 raw 1080p NV12 frames are about 2.8 GB, outside the 1 GiB core. Never load a whole raw clip/reference into RAM.
scenarios.sequence: Only after that integration is reviewed: one final UVD action per fresh physical cold boot, across three same-build cold-boot observations with completed UART. No automatic repeat or same-boot second decode.
scenarios.evidence: Exact 900-frame NV12 bytes/per-frame hashes, zero mismatch/software fallback/terminal fault, actual loaded driver and completed UART; historical results do not qualify a new build.
scenarios.limits: One explicit UVD attempt is the final active action of a fresh physical cold boot. Record completed UART continuity and keep capture running through physical power-off/known-good Orbis recovery. No same-boot retry, second decoder, reset, unload, unbind, rearm, suspend or automatic Linux power recovery.

scenarios.title: Additional 8-bit H.264 profiles/features
scenarios.fixture: Candidate 8-bit 4:2:0 AVC fixtures only; no additional profile or feature is promised supported.
scenarios.preparation: Review actual driver capabilities and parser/session limits before selecting profiles, entropy coding, B/reference frames, reference counts, slice structure or crop/stride cases. Prepare one pinned exact-reference fixture per approved variable.
scenarios.sequence: Review and implement a bounded harness first, then change one approved feature per separately planned fresh-cold-boot final UVD action. Do not turn this list into an automatic suite.
scenarios.evidence: Record the reviewed stream features and exact reference output, hardware path, resource observations and UART. Unsupported cases remain unsupported; no HEVC, 10-bit, 4K, encoding or concurrent-session claim.
scenarios.limits: One explicit UVD attempt is the final active action of a fresh physical cold boot. Record completed UART continuity and keep capture running through physical power-off/known-good Orbis recovery. No same-boot retry, second decoder, reset, unload, unbind, rearm, suspend or automatic Linux power recovery.

checks.title: Qualify paced AVC picture/audio and seeking
checks.scope: One active 8-bit NV12 AVC session, 1080p30 scope: 60 minutes per boot, measured PTS/wall speed, visible picture/audio and source-approved seek/flush/clip changes.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

scenarios.title: Bounded playback and resource monitoring
scenarios.fixture: Planned single-handle 8-bit 1080p30 playback with a pinned clip/reference; current 120-frame action has a 60-second decode timeout and is not an endurance harness.
scenarios.preparation: Implement/review one bounded player and read-only resource sampler. First propose 5-minute, then 30-minute windows before the unchanged 60-minute qualification gate; no timeout override or unbounded loop in the current action.
scenarios.sequence: Each window is a separate final UVD action on a fresh physical cold boot. The full card still requires three 3600-second runs/cold boots; shorter exploratory windows cannot satisfy it.
scenarios.evidence: Measure PTS/wall speed, picture/audio and decoder/display drops, RSS/available memory, available handle/resource counters, actual libraries, temperatures and UART faults. Missing counters stay unknown; fence counts do not prove DMA quiescence.
scenarios.limits: One explicit UVD attempt is the final active action of a fresh physical cold boot. Record completed UART continuity and keep capture running through physical power-off/known-good Orbis recovery. No same-boot retry, second decoder, reset, unload, unbind, rearm, suspend or automatic Linux power recovery.

checks.title: Fix then qualify close/reopen and resource exhaustion
checks.scope: Observed exhaustion/command-rejection path must be fixed at its source. Only then qualify20 sequential close/reopen/clip changes per boot without leaked admission/resources; no quota-only workaround.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

scenarios.title: Source-gated close/reopen and exhaustion work
scenarios.fixture: No executable alpha lifecycle or resource-exhaustion scenario is available.
scenarios.preparation: Fix/review ownership,close/reopen,admission and resource accounting before proposing any lifecycle harness. The existing 20-reopen gate remains blocked by current retained-DMA restrictions; do not raise a quota to hide failure.
scenarios.sequence: Current one-attempt-per-boot/final-active-action policy stays in force. Any future source-approved bounded lifecycle experiment requires a fresh physical cold boot and a separately planned sequence within the authorized experiment; no present menu action runs reopen loops or a second decoder.
scenarios.evidence: Preserve command rejections/exhaustion and ownership evidence; later demonstrate bounded resources, reusable handles and zero faults under the unchanged card gates. Success of the baseline or a long clip cannot close this source gap.
scenarios.limits: One explicit UVD attempt is the final active action of a fresh physical cold boot. Record completed UART continuity and keep capture running through physical power-off/known-good Orbis recovery. No same-boot retry, second decoder, reset, unload, unbind, rearm, suspend or automatic Linux power recovery.

checks.title: Fix then verify unsupported concurrency rejection
checks.scope: One active handle: an unsupported second decoder/tab must reject safely without closing the valid runtime. Do not run until admission/source safety is reviewed.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Establish DMA ownership and supported shutdown lifecycle
checks.scope: Prove ownership, quiescence and safe supported transitions before ordinary cleanup/reset/PM is enabled. Current retained-DMA restrictions remain; fence counts are insufficient.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: LED/buzzer/fan/clock control gap inventory
checks.scope: Only explicitly supported controls may be claimed after per-model source review and external observation. This CLI never writes ICC/PWM/clock/LED/buzzer state.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

checks.title: Record optional optical/other device identities
checks.scope: Read-only PCI/sysfs inventory for present devices; absent, untested and unsupported stay distinct. No media mounts, ejects or device commands.
checks.evidence: Exact artifact pins, per-run records, completed UART and reviewed operator observations.

smoke.policy: Only explicit --smoke --run submits fixed controller jobs. One foundation per boot, UVD final and once. No reset/unload/retry, connection changes or power commands.

coverage_gaps.reason: Standard five-step browser video is a software/VP8 playback smoke, not UVD proof. A separate browser hardware-decoder scenario needs its own exact matched terminal integration; never chain a second UVD attempt.
Select exactly one terminal scenario: canonical-120, native720-900 or native1080-900. Unselected fixtures remain NOT_RUN; one boot never chains a second decoder or establishes the other resolutions.
One immutable UVD intent per boot. Close/reopen, concurrency, resource exhaustion, DMA drain, reset and suspend remain source-gated, not executable smoke loops.
Power-off/reboot are a separate captured operator stage after saved evidence; this command sends no power/kexec/ICC command.
Native 48 kHz remains deferred. 44.1 kHz playback needs an actual audible pitch/duration observation.
No radio/pairing/reset is performed. Wi-Fi/Bluetooth claims require specific device/firmware observations or a reproducible bug, not inventory alone.
Cold-boot counts, endurance, physical HDMI/overscan, HID events, RTC reference drift and other manual cards remain visible in all 45 coverage rows. One smoke cannot satisfy those qualification gates.
